title.en: Power Factor: Electric 50 Concrete Pump keeps Diesel 40 is 4108 / 66 kW
title.zh: 功率 因数：订电动50时，邢台的订单要点明三行石子中的一行保留「是 26 m³/h。」

description.en: Electric 50 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-50-concrete-pump. Diesel 40 is 4108 / 66 kW 24 mm stone is 60 m / 180 m
description.zh: 订电动50时，邢台的订单要点明三行石子中的一行见 /products/electric-50-concrete-pump。是 26 m³/h。细石是 150 m / 350 m。

h1.en: "Leading" or "Lagging" Power Factors is the heading; Electric 50 Concrete Pump stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「"超前" 或 "滞后" 功率 因数」，主体仍是订电动50时，邢台的订单要点明三行石子中的一行

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Electric 50 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/electric-50-concrete-pump. Diesel 40 is 4108 / 66 kW. 24 mm stone is 60 m / 180 m. 13 mm stone is 80 m / 240 m. Fine stone is 150 m / 350 m. 150 m and 60 m are not a 105 m catalogue distance. Diesel 50 also prints 30 MPa but at 30 m³/h on a diesel engine. Send the stone label with /en/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/ to /en/contact/. The motor is 55 kW, pressure 30 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, frame 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm and weight 2800 kg. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 50 with one output, 26 m³/h, and three conveying pairs. The section title “Power Factor” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是订电动50时，邢台的订单要点明三行石子中的一行的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-50-concrete-pump。是 26 m³/h。细石是 150 m / 350 m。柴油40是 4108 / 66 kW。24 mm 石子是 60 m / 180 m。13 mm 石子是 80 m / 240 m。150 m 和 60 m 不是目录上的 105 m。柴油50也印 30 MPa，但是柴油机上的 30 m³/h。河北品锦机械（邢台）给电动50印一个输送量 26 m³/h 和三组距离。把石子标题和 /zh/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/ 发到 /zh/contact/。电机 55 kW，压力 30 MPa，料斗 0.4 m³，外形 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm，重量 2800 kg。节标题「功率 因数」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

body.en: This section is titled “Power Factor”. Electric 50 Concrete Pump still prints the cells below. Diesel 40 is 4108 / 66 kW. 150 m and 60 m are not a 105 m catalogue distance. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 50 with one output, 26 m³/h, and three conveying pairs.
body.zh: 本节标题是「功率 因数」。订电动50时，邢台的订单要点明三行石子中的一行下面这些格子仍是印出来的。柴油40是 4108 / 66 kW。150 m 和 60 m 不是目录上的 105 m。是 26 m³/h。

heading.zh: "超前" 或 "滞后" 功率 因数

body.en: Under “"Leading" or "Lagging" Power Factors”, Electric 50 Concrete Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. 24 mm stone is 60 m / 180 m. Diesel 50 also prints 30 MPa but at 30 m³/h on a diesel engine.
body.zh: 在「"超前" 或 "滞后" 功率 因数」下，订电动50时，邢台的订单要点明三行石子中的一行这一节只放已印出的格子。24 mm 石子是 60 m / 180 m。柴油50也印 30 MPa，但是柴油机上的 30 m³/h。把石子标题和 /zh/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/ 发到 /zh/contact/。

heading.en: Power Factor for a Three-Phase Motor
heading.zh: 功率 因数 用于 三-相 电机

body.en: “Power Factor for a Three-Phase Motor” titles this part of the Electric 50 Concrete Pump note. The figures stay the printed ones. 13 mm stone is 80 m / 240 m. Send the stone label with /en/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/ to /en/contact/.
body.zh: 「功率 因数 用于 三-相 电机」是订电动50时，邢台的订单要点明三行石子中的一行这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。13 mm 石子是 80 m / 240 m。河北品锦机械（邢台）给电动50印一个输送量 26 m³/h 和三组距离。

heading.zh: 典型 电机 功率 因数

body.en: For Electric 50 Concrete Pump, the heading “Typical Motor Power Factors” does not replace a cell. Fine stone is 150 m / 350 m. The motor is 55 kW, pressure 30 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, frame 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm and weight 2800 kg. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/power-factor-electrical-motor-d_654.html.
body.zh: 对订电动50时，邢台的订单要点明三行石子中的一行而言，标题「典型 电机 功率 因数」并不替换任何格子。细石是 150 m / 350 m。电机 55 kW，压力 30 MPa，料斗 0.4 m³，外形 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm，重量 2800 kg。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/power-factor-electrical-motor-d_654.html。

question.en: Does “Power Factor” replace Diesel 40 is 4108 / 66 kW?
question.zh: 「功率 因数」会替换「是 26 m³/h。」吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 40 is 4108 / 66 kW remains the printed wording for Electric 50 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。是 26 m³/h。仍是订电动50时，邢台的订单要点明三行石子中的一行已印的说法。

question.en: Where does 24 mm stone is 60 m / 180 m belong on the Electric 50 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 订电动50时，邢台的订单要点明三行石子中的一行这一行里，「细石是 150 m / 350 m。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-50-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-50-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “"Leading" or "Lagging" Power Factors” add to Electric 50 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「"超前" 或 "滞后" 功率 因数」给订电动50时，邢台的订单要点明三行石子中的一行增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/power-factor-electrical-motor-d_654.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/power-factor-electrical-motor-d_654.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
